svg.title: ATAG — Text as a character chain
svg.desc: Text has an Annotation. Below, ATAG represents the text as a linked chain of the characters t, e, x, t. The annotation points to the first character through STANDOFF_START and the last through STANDOFF_END.

g.text: ATAG — TEXT AS A CHARACTER CHAIN
Character nodes and standoff links belong to ATAG.
